line: Who needs a visa? What can't you bring? Three friends, three passports, one trip.
This is Waypoint, running in a simulated Alexa+ host. Each traveler carries their own passport.
I type one sentence. Waypoint creates the trip, then runs nine real tool calls across services. Every step names its source.
Then it opens the trip panel, an MCP app.
Ana and Sam need no visa. Priya needs an e-visa before she travels.
Each rule is checked against its quoted source before it is served. This pack has not been reviewed by a person yet, and Waypoint says so.
Sam and Priya each square up with Ana, to the cent.
Real MCP over Streamable HTTP, protocol 2025 11 25. Twenty-four tools, and these are the actual requests.
New session. Same trip, same travelers, same open tasks. Nothing re-entered. The same server also backs a classic Alexa skill.
